subject: [hw] T01: retraction -- VMOVN.I16 expected value was wrong, interpreter is right
body: R1 corrected me: `VMOVN.I16` narrows 16-bit source elements to 8-bit destination, so `vmovn.i16 d1,q0` with q0=0x12345678 per 32-bit lane legitimately gives 0x34783478. Please disregard my earlier "narrow decode wrong" message; the encoding my test used is working as specified. I still see k_i8_loop/k_i16_loop/k_i16_mul/k_neon_vmla16/k_neon_vsubl failing at arm-O2, but the root cause is not this. I will re-run after V20s VEXT fix and report with a trace if anything remains.
